title: Izwi Elithule Lesigodi
intro: Buyela emuva esikhathini uye kubantu abanamandla abake bathola isimangaliso esiphilayo njengesivivinyo. Ukuzikhukhumeza kanye nenkani kwavala isiphetho sabo. Ungakwazi yini ukulandelela indaba bese uthola ukuthi kwenzekani kulesi sigameko esimangalisayo?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesivivinyo saphezulu kubantu abanamandla abaziwa ngamandla abo nokungalaleli kwabo.
Ngangiyisimangaliso esiyingqayizivele—abantu abafana nami babengakaze bavele phakathi kwabo.
Ngabelana ngamanzi okuphuza avela emthonjeni nabantu bakithi ngezinsuku ezishintshanayo.
Baxwayiswa ngokuthi noma yikuphi ukungilimaza kuzoletha isijeziso esisheshayo.
Abanesibindi kakhulu kubo basishaya indiva isixwayiso futhi banginquma imisipha.
Ngemva kokufa kwami, ukukhala okukodwa okukhulu okuvela phezulu kwabhubhisa bonke abantu bami.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
